module: GE extension `core_orthoCamera`: enables an orthographic view (no perspective) on the main view of the OnlyGui object, via scenetree.OnlyGui:setOrthoMainView. You set the near and far planes and the size of the orthographic window (either left/right/top/bottom, or a `size` with the window ratio). Also contains an ImGui debug window (debugMode, hardcoded off).
notes: With useWindowAspectRatio (true by default), left/right/top/bottom are recomputed from `size`: height = size, width = size * ratio of the GraphicDisplayResolutions setting resolution (1280x720 if absent). The ratio is recomputed on every onWindowResized.
If useWindowAspectRatio is false, the left/right/top/bottom bounds given to enable are used as is (defaults -1, 1, 1, -1).

Default values of enable: nearClip 1, farClip 5000, size 1. setOptions changes neither the bounds nor the enabled state, only size, nearClip and farClip, then recomputes the bounds if the window ratio is used.
The units of sizes and clip planes are world units (meters), inferred from code.
No specific disable code: enable(false) simply sends enabled = false to setOrthoMainView. Before the first enable, the hooks do nothing (enabled == nil).
Potential bug: updateAspectRatio does w, h = resolutionString:match(...) then tonumber(w); if the string does not match the pattern, w is nil and the w / h computation fails.
The `size` parameter of the onWindowResized hook shadows the module's local variable `size` (unused).

enable.desc: Enables or disables the main orthographic view and sets its parameters (bounds, clip planes, size).

options.desc: { left, right, top, bottom, nearClip, farClip, size, useWindowAspectRatio }; useWindowAspectRatio is true if absent.

setOptions.desc: Updates size, nearClip and farClip (defaults 1, 1, 5000) and reapplies the orthographic view if it has already been configured.

getSize.desc: Returns the current vertical size of the orthographic view.

onWindowResized.desc: Hook called when the window is resized: recomputes the ratio and reapplies the view.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: displays the ImGui debug window 'OnlyGui OrthoMainView' only if debugMode is true (false in the shipped code, so inactive).
